covers: Wall Street's first hour and the JSE close on Thursday 12 November 2026 (to 17:43 SAST)
headline: Nvidia cuts its fall to about 5% after Huang's resignation; Trump says Tim Cook should run Nvidia; US home sales hit a 15-year low
summary: Nvidia was at $164.70 at 17:43 SAST, down 5.2% from Wednesday's $173.70 close and off its earlier low, while the S&P 500 (7,603.70) and Nasdaq (25,358.78) were 0.2% and 0.4% below Wednesday's closes (LRC Stock Scanner and LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 17:43 SAST). The JSE All Share ended at 112,894.87 and the Top 40 at 104,981.31, with gold miners down 3-4%, and the rand weakened to R16.77/$ (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026). Gold fell further to $3,868.10 and the US 10-year yield rose to 5.07% as US existing-home sales dropped to their lowest level since 2010, per MarketWatch (LRC Market Dashboard, 12 Nov 2026 17:43 SAST; MarketWatch headline, 12 Nov 2026 17:01 SAST).

items.title: Nvidia: Huang resigns, Kress interim CEO; Trump says Tim Cook should take over
items.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO and Colette Kress is interim chief. CNBC's live coverage reports President Trump saying Apple's Tim Cook should replace Huang. Nvidia was at $164.70 at 17:43 SAST, down 5.2% from Wednesday's $173.70 close, recovering from $159.28 (-8.3%) at 16:40 SAST.
items.source: CNBC headlines, 12 Nov 2026 16:39 and 17:40 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance NVDA), 12 Nov 2026 16:40 and 17:43 SAST, and 11 Nov 2026 close

items.summary: MarketWatch reports existing-home sales dropped to their lowest level since the Great Recession. The US 10-year Treasury yield was 5.07% at 17:43 SAST, up from 5.03% at 16:40 SAST.
